dct_description_sm: This dataset contains trails designated as Provincial Trails (Designation = 'Designated and Provincial'). Provincial Trails are established under the Public Lands Act through Ministerial Order. Available attributes are limited and include trail name, legislation, and designation information. This dataset is intended for mapping, analysis, and reference purposes. Note: Trail name information has not been fully validated and should not be considered authoritative. Users should verify trail names and other attribute information through authoritative sources where required.
